title_original: ‘Vicarious wish-fulfillment’: why That Thing You Do! is my feelgood movie
editorial_title_zh: “替代性的愿望实现”：为什么《挡不住的奇迹》是我的治愈系电影
editorial_excerpt_zh: 在我们持续推出作家讲述他们重看最多的治愈系电影的系列文章中，最新一篇是回到90年代，回顾汤姆·汉克斯这部以60年代为背景的深情音乐喜剧。“我们是怎么走到这一步的？”这是《挡不住的奇迹》中史蒂夫·扎恩的角色向他的乐队成员发出的…

"这是我在过去30年里多次想起的一个时刻。有时，这是我所向往的时刻，有时也是我亲身感受到的时刻。当乐队第一次在收音机里听到他们的歌时，那是我在电影中见见过最具热情洋溢的时刻之一。那种欣快感对于任何曾感受过创作成功喜悦的人来说都是触手可及的——而我们难道不都以这样或那样的方式经历过吗？这就是为什么《挡不住的奇迹》成了我的治愈系电影。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "在1996年，汤姆·汉克斯正处于好莱坞的巅峰。他连续两年赢得奥斯卡最佳男主角奖，并且拥有1995年票房最高两部电影《玩具总动员》和《阿波罗13号》。我猜他当时想做什么都可以。我将永远感激他选择自编自导并参演这部对1960年代流行音乐充满柔情与温和的赞歌。这是一部如此温暖的电影，无论何时看其中任何一个场景，都会立刻让我感到更加快乐。", "links": [{"text": "Tom Hanks", "url": "https://www.theguardian.com/film/tomhanks"}], "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "影片核心的虚构流行乐队名叫“奇迹乐队”（the Wonders）。他们从披头士乐队身上汲取灵感，最初将团名拼写为“Oneders”，但由于总是被介绍成“oh-need-ers”，他们被迫改了名。当盖伊·帕特森（汤姆·埃弗レット·斯科特饰）临时加入担任鼓手，并即兴加快了他们的歌曲《挡不住的奇迹》（That Thing You Do!）的节奏时，这支乐队一飞冲天。这首歌迅速吸引了当地餐馆老板、推广人，以及不久后的一位名叫怀特先生（汉克斯饰）的唱片制作人的注意。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "这首歌推动了剧情的发展，也是这部电影的超能力所在。由已故的来自韦恩喷泉乐队的亚当·施莱辛格创作，《挡不住的奇迹》在整部电影中不断响起，而你总是乐于听到它。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "电影本身就像其同名主题曲一样，拥有快节奏和轻快的旋律，在108分钟的时长里疾速推进。他们的唱片在排行榜上不断攀升，各种机遇以令人眩晕的速度接踵而至，仿佛他们的成功永远不会停止。然而，创作上的紧张关系、不愉快的恋情以及职业追求却横亘其中，威胁着要像开始时那样迅速终结他们的辉煌。而事实上，它们确实做到了。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "我想正是这一点让这部电影如此特别。它提供了替代性的愿望实现，却没有回避令人清醒的现实。它并没有那种我认为治愈系电影本能上所必需的美满大结局。相反，依恋与怅惘占据了主导，比起脚趾打拍子，你更有可能感到喉头微微哽咽。当一切土崩瓦解时，那种刺痛是毋庸置疑的，但它并不是大多数演艺圈警世故事里那种致命的创伤。这部电影跳动着一颗博大的心，以一种滑稽、欢快而又鼓舞人心的方式分享着清醒的智慧。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "在最近的一次采访中，马修·瑞斯表示汉克斯给他的建议是“这也会过去”。这被作为对坏日子和好日子共同的提醒。同样的一种谦逊感也贯穿于《挡不住的奇迹》之中。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "整部电影还洋溢着一种善良。这里没有真正的反派。郁郁寡欢的天才吉米可能会被视为反派，但他的清高也有其道理。还有肤浅的蒂娜（查理兹·塞隆饰），她虽然不感兴趣却从未残忍。或者那个喜剧般严厉的父亲（霍尔姆斯·奥斯本饰）。就连那个对音乐漠不关心的怪诞人物索尔·西勒（亚历克斯·罗科），作为唱片公司老板也因促成了这一切而功不可没。他们都有各自的目的和个性。他们虽然受到了一点戏谑，但也得到了宽容。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "这种治愈的氛围还得益于乐队迷人的情谊、吉米女友菲伊（丽芙·泰勒饰）的活力，以及汉克斯本人——他本可以把这个角色演得夸张或完全刻板，但他却既带来了欢笑又饱含深情，同时从未喧宾夺主。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "11岁时看这部电影，我觉得汉克斯太老了。现在，我觉得他看起来好年轻。他拍这部电影时大约40岁，这大致是我目前的年纪。结局过去比现在更让我感到刺痛。我过去常想：“要是这个角色当时那样做了，乐队本可以不解散的。”但现在我看着它，仿佛汉克斯在轻声说道：“在名气与幸福之间，选择幸福。”", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "汉克斯先生，我希望您两者都找到了。这是我向您表达感谢的方式，感谢您带给我们这份电影礼物。愿这部充满奇迹的电影能给更多代人带来欢乐。", "translated": true}, {"type": "list_item", "text": "《挡不住的奇迹》在美国可在 Pluto 上观看，在英国可进行数字租赁，在澳大利亚可在 Disney+ 上观看", "translated": true}, article_text:
“How did we get here?” That’s the question Steve Zahn’s character in That Thing You Do! asks his bandmate with bemusement right before they perform on live television.

It’s a moment I have thought of many times over the past 30 years. Sometimes, it’s been a moment I’ve aspired to, and sometimes it’s a moment I’ve felt myself. When the band hears their song on the radio for the first time, it’s one of the most ebullient moments I’ve ever seen on film. There is a euphoria that is recognizable for anyone who has ever felt the joy of a creative accomplishment – and isn’t that all of us, in one way or another? That’s what makes That Thing You Do! my feelgood movie.

In 1996, Tom Hanks was on top of Hollywood. He had back-to-back best actor Oscar wins, and two of 1995’s highest-grossing films with Toy Story and Apollo 13. I presume he could have done anything he wanted. I will be forever grateful that he chose to write, direct and co-star in this modest, gentle ode to 1960s pop music. It’s a movie of such warmth that any scene viewed at any time will instantly make me happier.

The fictional pop band at the center of the film is named the Wonders. Taking inspiration from the Beatles, they initially spell their name as the Oneders, but are forced to change when they repeatedly get introduced as the “oh-need-ers”. The band soar to fame when Guy Patterson (Tom Everett Scott) sits in as drummer and spontaneously ups the tempo of their song, That Thing You Do!. The song quickly garners the attention of local restaurateurs, promoters and, soon enough, a record producer named Mr White (Hanks).

The song drives the plot and is also the film’s superpower. Written by the late Adam Schlesinger of Fountains of Wayne, That Thing You Do! plays constantly throughout the movie and you’re always happy to hear it.

The film itself resembles the fast beat and breezy melody of its title track as it zips through its 108-minute running time. Their record climbs the charts and opportunities present themselves at a dizzying speed that suggests their success will never let up. But creative tensions, unhappy relationships and professional callings get in the way, threatening to end their run as quickly as it started. And, indeed, they do.

I think that’s what makes this film so special. It offers vicarious wish-fulfillment but doesn’t shy away from sobering reality. There isn’t the blissfully happy ending that I’d instinctually consider necessary for a feelgood movie. Instead, wistfulness takes the lead and you’re more likely to feel a tiny lump in your throat than a tap in your toe. When things fall apart, it’s an undeniable sting, but it’s not a mortal wound the way it is in most cautionary tales of show business. There’s a big beating heart in this movie that shares clear-eyed wisdom in a way that is funny, cheerful and encouraging.

In a recent interview, Matthew Rhys said that the advice he received from Hanks was “this too shall pass.” This was given as a reminder for both the bad days and the good days. That same sense of humility pulses through That Thing You Do!.

There is also a sense of kindness throughout. There are no real villains here. Jimmy, the brooding talent, could be the villain, but he has a point with his self-righteousness. There’s also the superficial Tina (Charlize Theron) who is uninterested but never cruel. Or the comically hard-nosed dad (Holmes Osborne). Even the grotesque Sol Siler (Alex Rocco), who couldn’t care less about the music, still gets credit for making things possible as the head of the record label. They all have a purpose and identity. They receive a little ribbing, but also grace.

The feelgood vibes are also fueled by the charming camaraderie of the band, the effervescence of Jimmy’s girlfriend Faye (Liv Tyler) and Hanks himself, who could have played this over-the-top or completely straight but instead delivers both laughter and poignancy while never overshadowing the cast.

Hanks seemed so old to me when I saw this at 11. Now, I think he looks so young. He was around 40 at the time he made this, which is roughly my current age. The ending used to sting me more than it does now. I used to think: “If only this character had done that, the band could have stayed together.” But now I watch it, and it’s as if Hanks is quietly saying: “Between fame and happiness, choose happiness.”

Mr Hanks, I hope you’ve found both. This is my way of saying thank you for giving us this cinematic gift. May this “onederful” film bring joy to many more generations.

That Thing You Do! is available on Pluto in the US, to rent digitally in the UK and to watch on Disney+ in Australia

title_original: ‘The Cycle’ Is a Surprising New Take on the Police Procedural, With a Huge Twist and an Emotional Resonance the Director Didn’t Expect
article_blocks_json: [{"type": "paragraph", "text": "SPOILER ALERT: This article contains major spoilers for “ The Cycle ,” now streaming on Shudder.", "links": [{"text": "The Cycle", "url": "https://variety.com/t/the-cycle/"}]}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "What if a werewolf continued to transform even after its death?"}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "This light bulb idea came to frequent collaborators Jordan Downey and Kevin Stewart as they were sketching out a TV treatment for their 2018 film “The Head Hunter.”"}, {"type": "heading", "text": "Related Stories"}, {"type": "image", "url": "https://variety.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/Zarna_MayHeadshots-8.jpeg?crop=416px%2C254px%2C4153px%2C2771px&resize=250%2C167", "alt": "Evoto", "caption": "", "credit": "Variety · Film"}, {"type": "heading", "text": "Zarna Garg Sets Netflix Stand-Up Comedy Special (EXCLUSIVE)", "links": [{"text": "Zarna Garg Sets Netflix Stand-Up Comedy Special (EXCLUSIVE)", "url": "https://variety.com/2026/tv/news/zarna-garg-netflix-stand-up-comedy-special-1236937435/"}]}, {"type": "image", "url": "https://variety.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/Emily-Feingold-Headshot-1-rotated-e1793937999390.jpg?w=250&h=167&crop=1", "alt": "Emily Feingold Disney", "caption": "", "credit": "Variety · Film"}, {"type": "heading", "text": "Netflix Alum Emily Feingold Joins Disney as Executive VP of Communications", "links": [{"text": "Netflix Alum Emily Feingold Joins Disney as Executive VP of Communications", "url": "https://variety.com/2026/tv/news/emily-feingold-disney-executive-vp-communications-netflix-1236940972/"}]}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "“We both looked at each other and stopped and were like, ‘Wait, that’s a really cool, fun idea and a take on werewolves that we’ve never seen before,’” Downey says. “Being the horror cinephiles that we are, we were like, ‘I don’t think anyone’s done that. I can’t think of a movie or a show.’ We Googled it and realized, no, it hasn’t been done. What do you do with that idea?”"}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "The result is “The Cycle,” a handsomely shot detective story following Meg (Deborah Ann Woll) and Marks (Jeffrey Donovan) as experts trying to solve a lycanthropic murder mystery — although the film largely keeps the exact supernatural entity a mystery, until the third act goes full creature feature."}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "Downey, who co-wrote the film with Stewart and directed it, thought that outsized hook would benefit from a recognizable framing."}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "“Right away, it felt like it fit best into a crime mystery, a police procedural,” he says. “Ultimately, if you have this werewolf that is going to reanimate and then at dawn turn back into a man — but in this case it’s a deceased man who doesn’t move, walk, talk, has no life — that would just be dumbfounding to police. They would come into this crime scene and they would see these victims, but then they’d find this naked dead guy not knowing that he’s harboring something supernatural. So it made sense that there really wasn’t another package to put it into.”"}, {"type": "image", "url": "https://variety.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/MCDTHCY_IZ014-1000.jpg", "alt": "", "caption": "“The Cycle” ©AMC/courtesy Everett Collection", "credit": "Variety · Film"}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "Once the case is cracked, the third act shifts hard into monster movie mode, complete with plenty of practical blood, guts and werewolf nastiness."}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "“I love creature features,” Downey says. “I didn’t want it to be this ‘elevated,’ pretentious experience that didn’t give monster movie fans the proper experience. You go into ‘The Cycle’ not knowing that’s what’s coming. I thought what would happen is the characters would be thrust into a completely crazy change in their lives, that they now exist in a world where werewolves can be real and there’s one in proximity to them. That change would be as shocking to them as it hopefully would be to the audience. So we were aware of trying to do things early in the movie, so when that tonal shift happens, it felt earned but also surprising.”"}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "Ushering in the change of pace was the transformation scene, which is one of the most loved traditions in werewolf movies and was exciting for the team to plan for, along with key special effects artist and supervisor Patrick Magee."}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "“The first thing was acknowledging that if you’re going to make a werewolf movie, we didn’t want to run from that challenge,” Downey says. “In the ’80s, Rob Bottin and Rick Baker nailed it with ‘The Howling’ and ‘An American Werewolf in London.’ In the years since, people have shied away from it because either it’s too expensive, too time-consuming or maybe there’s a clever new way of doing it. But we just felt like enough time had gone where we hadn’t seen that done very well for so many years. So we said right away, ‘If we’re going to do this, we have to do a proper werewolf transformation. We have to nail it.’ We storyboarded it a lot. We talked about it a lot. We broke down the best scenes that had been done and thought about … Do we want to see foot? Do we want to see hands? Do we want to see eyes, teeth? Is it a spinal cord? All of the different things that we wanted to see in our scene, and then how it would apply to an undead corpse version of a transformation."}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "Beyond the horror element, the film examines the complex choices that can come with fatherhood, which comes most notably via Meg, who learns that her long-lost parent is the werewolf at the heart of the story."}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "“It wasn’t in the first drafts, to be honest,” Downey says. “In our initial treatments, Meg was investigating a stranger. It was the same concept that a man’s body was discovered, the police didn’t know how he was tied to these murders, and they went to her because she was an expert in her field, but he wasn’t her father. We got her into Act Three, when she went to the house, just like in the movie where they go to investigate his whereabouts and the life of the recluse. We felt like she was putting herself in this really dangerous position, without some kind of an emotional tie to that character. I told Kevin that I don’t believe that the character would do this given the circumstances. We were also missing something that I thought is really important in horror films, which is the heart and the pathos of a monster movie and the tragedy. So then, we came up with the idea that, ‘OK, what if this is her father?’ So now we’ve anchored something to her emotionally. SPOILER ALERT: This article contains major spoilers for “ The Cycle ,” now streaming on Shudder.

What if a werewolf continued to transform even after its death?

This light bulb idea came to frequent collaborators Jordan Downey and Kevin Stewart as they were sketching out a TV treatment for their 2018 film “The Head Hunter.”

Netflix Alum Emily Feingold Joins Disney as Executive VP of Communications

“We both looked at each other and stopped and were like, ‘Wait, that’s a really cool, fun idea and a take on werewolves that we’ve never seen before,’” Downey says. “Being the horror cinephiles that we are, we were like, ‘I don’t think anyone’s done that. I can’t think of a movie or a show.’ We Googled it and realized, no, it hasn’t been done. What do you do with that idea?”

The result is “The Cycle,” a handsomely shot detective story following Meg (Deborah Ann Woll) and Marks (Jeffrey Donovan) as experts trying to solve a lycanthropic murder mystery — although the film largely keeps the exact supernatural entity a mystery, until the third act goes full creature feature.

Downey, who co-wrote the film with Stewart and directed it, thought that outsized hook would benefit from a recognizable framing.

“Right away, it felt like it fit best into a crime mystery, a police procedural,” he says. “Ultimately, if you have this werewolf that is going to reanimate and then at dawn turn back into a man — but in this case it’s a deceased man who doesn’t move, walk, talk, has no life — that would just be dumbfounding to police. They would come into this crime scene and they would see these victims, but then they’d find this naked dead guy not knowing that he’s harboring something supernatural. So it made sense that there really wasn’t another package to put it into.”

Once the case is cracked, the third act shifts hard into monster movie mode, complete with plenty of practical blood, guts and werewolf nastiness.

“I love creature features,” Downey says. “I didn’t want it to be this ‘elevated,’ pretentious experience that didn’t give monster movie fans the proper experience. You go into ‘The Cycle’ not knowing that’s what’s coming. I thought what would happen is the characters would be thrust into a completely crazy change in their lives, that they now exist in a world where werewolves can be real and there’s one in proximity to them. That change would be as shocking to them as it hopefully would be to the audience. So we were aware of trying to do things early in the movie, so when that tonal shift happens, it felt earned but also surprising.”

Ushering in the change of pace was the transformation scene, which is one of the most loved traditions in werewolf movies and was exciting for the team to plan for, along with key special effects artist and supervisor Patrick Magee.

“The first thing was acknowledging that if you’re going to make a werewolf movie, we didn’t want to run from that challenge,” Downey says. “In the ’80s, Rob Bottin and Rick Baker nailed it with ‘The Howling’ and ‘An American Werewolf in London.’ In the years since, people have shied away from it because either it’s too expensive, too time-consuming or maybe there’s a clever new way of doing it. But we just felt like enough time had gone where we hadn’t seen that done very well for so many years. So we said right away, ‘If we’re going to do this, we have to do a proper werewolf transformation. We have to nail it.’ We storyboarded it a lot. We talked about it a lot. We broke down the best scenes that had been done and thought about … Do we want to see foot? Do we want to see hands? Do we want to see eyes, teeth? Is it a spinal cord? All of the different things that we wanted to see in our scene, and then how it would apply to an undead corpse version of a transformation.

Beyond the horror element, the film examines the complex choices that can come with fatherhood, which comes most notably via Meg, who learns that her long-lost parent is the werewolf at the heart of the story.

“It wasn’t in the first drafts, to be honest,” Downey says. “In our initial treatments, Meg was investigating a stranger. It was the same concept that a man’s body was discovered, the police didn’t know how he was tied to these murders, and they went to her because she was an expert in her field, but he wasn’t her father. We got her into Act Three, when she went to the house, just like in the movie where they go to investigate his whereabouts and the life of the recluse. We felt like she was putting herself in this really dangerous position, without some kind of an emotional tie to that character. I told Kevin that I don’t believe that the character would do this given the circumstances. We were also missing something that I thought is really important in horror films, which is the heart and the pathos of a monster movie and the tragedy. So then, we came up with the idea that, ‘OK, what if this is her father?’ So now we’ve anchored something to her emotionally. We can work in the tragedy of this man who left, but it was in her mind for a terrible reason, a father walking out on their children. In his mind, it was to protect them. And once we had that for her father, then we started to apply that theme to some of the other characters.”

Much like the cycle of undead werewolves, it’s easy to see this story carry on through new chapters. Downey says he’s happy keeping “The Cycle” as a single story, but has also mulled over what a larger scope could be.

“I think this movie is self-contained and there’s versions of it that I would probably not be interested in,” Downey says. “But we did talk a lot about different stories. I think there’s a great prequel in the original werewolf that came from over the sea. There’s an aquatic, boat-set version of this story that I think would be interesting. You could do a TV series about the life and the trials of [Meg’s father] Peter Stump and all of the different things that he was doing while isolated for those 30 years. I think it’d be interesting to see … because she’s so good at her job, and in the final scene of the movie so confident that she’s gonna get this figured out. But what if she didn’t? What if 10, 15, 20 years goes by and she has not solved it and she is now facing the same dilemma her dad was, which was, ‘This fucking thing can’t be stopped.’ But by killing herself, that does nothing. Finding her at a point of quit would be really interesting. I’d only want to do stuff if Deborah and Jeffrey wanted to come back and work on it again, and if there were fans that wanted it to happen, but I would never say no.”

article_text:
From personal vulnerability to collective histories, ‘A Poem for Deep Thinkers’ traces the intersections of identity, memory and psychological unrest at the Museum of Contemporary Art Chicago.

What does it mean to navigate the complexities of Black identity in a world shaped by historical trauma and contemporary uncertainty? In ‘A Poem for Deep Thinkers ’ , acclaimed American artist Rashid Johnson returns to the Museum of Contemporary Art Chicago with an expansive exhibition that examines the relationships between race, cultural memory, philosophy, and the human psyche.

Bringing together more than 70 works spanning two decades, the exhibition traces Johnson’s evolving visual language, from the black-and-white photographs of The New Negro Escapist Social and Athletic Club , informed by W. E. B. Du Bois, to his Cosmic Slops reliefs constructed from black soap and wax. His Anxious Men and Broken Men series confront the psychological pressures of contemporary existence, transforming personal unease into a broader reflection on vulnerability, alienation and collective experience.

Returning to the institution that presented his early work, Johnson invites audiences to consider how material, gesture and cultural inheritance can articulate experiences that resist easy definition. The exhibition offers a compelling encounter with an artist who continually questions what it means to exist, remember, and endure.

This exhibition will be on view at the Museum of Contemporary Art Chicago , USA, from 7 November 2026 to 25 April 2027.

Community

A View From the Easel: Flor Khan

“Here, I am allowed to play, to not know the answers, to let the message evolve on its own timing.”

Welcome to the 358th installment of A View From the Easel, a series in which artists reflect on their workspace. This week, Flor Khan collapses time and tenderly revives the memories of her ancestors.

Want to take part? Check out our submission guidelines and share a bit about your studio with us through this form ! All mediums and workspaces are welcome, including your home studio.

Flor Khan , Bronx, New York City

How long have you been working in this space?

I have been working out of this particular space since March; before then, I worked in a number of artist studios and my own apartment.

Describe an average day in your studio.

The average day at the studio starts around 4pm, following my daytime job. Typically, I work on two to three pieces at once: Something is usually developing color in my photo processing work station, another piece is drying on the work line, and the other piece is steeping in tannins. If I'm lucky, I get to work with my sewing machine when the fabrics have dried. Before beginning my work, I turn on my salt lamp and light a candle for the ancestors; I ask for their permission to bring their memories back to life. With each stitch, and each photo transfer, I am brought closer to their memory, whether that's working with Victorian-era postcards featuring my Indo-Caribbean aunties or tapping into the photo albums of my late father. For background music, NPR 's Tiny Desk plays whichever artist is being featured for the week.

How does the space affect your work?

"由来：廃藩置県の行われた明治4（1871）年、初めて「群馬県」の名称が使用されたのが10月28日だったそうです。昭和58（1983）年に「あかぎ国体」が県民総参加で大成功を収めたことから県民意識が盛り上がり、昭和60（1985）年に制定されました。他に候補日が二つあって、県の統廃合で群馬県がほぼ現在の形となった明治9（1876）年8月21日と、「あかぎ国体」秋季大会開会の日であった10月15日とを比べた結果、名称使用の日となりました。新暦では12月10日が当たるそうですが、年末は気ぜわしく山間部では雪も降り始めるので、10月28日としたそうです。"}, 群馬県「群馬県民の日」10月28日

由来：廃藩置県の行われた明治4（1871）年、初めて「群馬県」の名称が使用されたのが10月28日だったそうです。昭和58（1983）年に「あかぎ国体」が県民総参加で大成功を収めたことから県民意識が盛り上がり、昭和60（1985）年に制定されました。他に候補日が二つあって、県の統廃合で群馬県がほぼ現在の形となった明治9（1876）年8月21日と、「あかぎ国体」秋季大会開会の日であった10月15日とを比べた結果、名称使用の日となりました。新暦では12月10日が当たるそうですが、年末は気ぜわしく山間部では雪も降り始めるので、10月28日としたそうです。

article_text:
Preview

Art Films We Look Forward to Watching at DOC NYC

Documentaries on a giant pencil that became a local watering hole, the afterlife of Frida Kahlo through her image, and collagist Romare Bearden are among the festival’s most enticing offerings.

Frida: The Girl Just Doesn't Go Away (2026), directed by Trisha Ziff (all images courtesy DOC NYC)

I’ve never put much thought into how I want to be portrayed after I die. Perhaps I’d opt to be plastered on Etsy mugs, tea sets, and journal covers, à la Frida Kahlo (though I doubt I’d have many buyers, or that Kahlo would’ve enjoyed how her self-image is often nowadays detached from the politics and life behind it), or I would begin things early by enlisting an artist to paint their best guess at my posthumous body. Maybe I'd like to be dipped in ink and stamped onto rice paper, as Molly Tenzer does with the roadkill she finds on New York City streets.

The lineup at this year’s DOC NYC, which returns to venues throughout the city from November 11 through November 29, offers many reflections on this question — and more regarding documentary's capacity to sensitively portray communities currently under threat, examine artists' legacies, and narrate some of art's most idiosyncratic stories. We’ve selected 13 films we’re looking forward to seeing in-person or online at the festival's 17th edition.

Frida: The Girl Just Doesn't Go Away

Village East by Angelika , 181-189 2nd Ave, East Village Nov. 14 & 16

Go to any gift shop in an art museum, and there’s a decent chance you’ll find Frida Kahlo’s image draped over mugs, t-shirts, or decorative tapestries. Simultaneously a political icon, feminist celebrity, and a global household brand, Kahlo presents an interesting case study about how artists’ images define their legacy long after their deaths. Director Trisha Ziff taps into the commercial fascination with Kahlo and how her image has taken on a distinct life from her motivations and work.

The Hummingbird Paints Fragrant Songs

SVA Theatre , 333 W 23rd St, Chelsea Nov. 11

The Hummingbird Paints Fragrant Songs (2026), directed by Èlia Gasull Balada and Matteo Norzi

Èlia Gasull Balada’s and Matteo Norzi’s documentary on Indigenous artist Sara Flores (Shipibo-Konibo) was born out of a decade-long collaboration during which the painter began to receive international recognition. Using natural dyes sourced from her home in the Peruvian Amazon, Flores paints intricate geometric patterns with striking symmetry. Equally channeling the visual and matrilineal language of the Shipibo-Konibo practice of Kené, Flores creates works as a form of resistance against environmental, political, and social ills.

In Scena è la rubrica dedicata agli spettacoli dal vivo in programmazione sui palchi di tutta Italia: ecco la nostra selezione della settimana, dal 19 al 25 ottobre.

Danza e teatro

L.A.V.A., l’eruzione dei corpi e delle tensioni umane

L.A.V.A. , la coproduzione internazionale che vede sul palcoscenico, insieme, la Compagnia Zappalà Danza e ICK Dans Amsterdam, dopo il debutto assoluto al Julidans Festival di Amsterdam e la successiva tournée nei Paesi Bassi, lo spettacolo debutta in prima nazionale a Catania (al Teatro Verga, dal 23 ottobre al 1° novembre, per la stagione del Teatro Stabile di Catania). Firmato a sei mani da Roberto Zappalà , Emio Greco e Pieter C. Scholten , unisce 12 danzatori e danzatrici in un viaggio fisico e sonoro, amplificato dal sound design di Salvador Breed.

Il lavoro attraversa il concetto di l’eruzione dei corpi e delle tensioni umane tracciando un sottile parallelismo tra le forze geologiche della terra e gli impulsi profondi dell’uomo. Così come il magma si accumula sotto la crosta terrestre prima di esplodere attraverso una frattura, anche nei corpi dei danzatori e nelle dinamiche delle società contemporanee le tensioni si addensano dal conflitto fino alla trasformazione.

Beckett e Pinter per Renato Carpentieri

È affidata al grande attore di teatro e cinema, Renato Carpentieri , l’apertura della stagione 26/27 del Teatro di Napoli – Teatro Nazionale, con L’ultimo nastro di Krapp di Samuel Beckett . Il cuore della scena è un “dialogo impossibile”: un uomo ascolta la propria voce registrata circa trent’anni prima e si confronta con il fantasma di sé stesso. La parola diventa archivio, traccia, residuo e la memoria un campo di battaglia. Un Krapp “archivista del nulla”, sospeso tra ironia e struggimento, tra lucidità e disfatta.

L’allestimento firmato dal regista di teatro, cinema, documentari e scrittore, Roberto Andò , accosta L’ultimo nastro di Krapp a Press Conference di Harold Pinter , in un dittico che indaga il rapporto fra parola, memoria e potere.

“ L’ultimo nastro di Krapp”, traduzione Carlo Fruttero; “Press Conference”, traduzione Alessandra Serra, regia Roberto Andò, con Renato Carpentieri, il bambino Agostino Cossia, scene e luci Gianni Carluccio, costumi Daniela Cernigliaro, suono Hubert Westkemper. Produzione Teatro di Napoli – Teatro Nazionale, Fondazione Campania dei Festival – Campania Teatro Festival. Al Teatro Mercadante, dal 21 ottobre al 1° novembre. In tournée.

Tutte le gerarchie di danza di Saïdo Lehlouh

Sono autodidatti. Hanno imparato a danzare nei cortili, nelle battle, nelle cantine. In Témoin , il coreografo Saïdo Lehlouh , che co-dirige, con il collettivo FAIR-E, il Centre Chorégraphique National di Rennes e della Bretagna, li chiama “testimoni”: della loro epoca, della loro danza, della loro generazione. In Témoin (a Reggio Emilia, Teatro Municipale Valli, il 24 Ottobre per il Festival Aperto) dentro un ambiente nebbioso, convivono senza gerarchie break, krump, electro, popping, whacking, freestyle, top rock. Ognuno porta il proprio vocabolario, la propria storia. La coreografia si costruisce nell’improvvisazione, dentro una dinamica di ascolto profondo, sull’energia dell’incontro — la stessa che attraversa le battle, da cui Lehlouh ricava il principio di composizione. Il virtuosismo c’è, e si sente, ma non è mai fine a se stesso: serve a far emergere le voci singole dentro un corpo collettivo.

HEIMAT Patria/Straniero

Cinque registi dirigono un cast di sette attrici ed attori del corso di II livello in recitazione dell’Accademia Nazionale d’Arte Drammatica Silvio d’Amico in cinque spettacoli con uno stesso tema: HEIMAT Patria/Straniero , intorno ad un medesimo dispositivo scenico per una maratona di cinque giorni (a Romaeuropa, Mattatoio, dal 21 al 25 ottobre).

Inaugura il regista svizzero Thom Luz autore di un personalissimo teatro musicale tra suono, spazio, e luce. Il suo sguardo, attento alle tracce invisibili della memoria e dell’appartenenza, apre con una riflessione sul rapporto tra casa, identità e straniamento.

Segue Edeyen di Letizia Russo , regia Leonardo Lidi con un racconto di attesa, perdita e appartenenza, in cui la ricerca di una casa possibile coincide con quella di un’identità; e Fabiana Iacozzilli con La trilogia di Belgrado della drammaturga serba Biljana Srbljanovic , dove, attraverso le storie di giovani sospesi tra guerra, esilio e desiderio di futuro, si esplorano i temi della perdita, dell’appartenenza e della ricerca di un luogo possibile da chiamare casa.

Tiago Rodrigues, dare voce a pagine mai scritte

In No Yogurt for the Dead , il regista e drammaturgo Tiago Rodrigues , parte da una storia vera e profondamente personale: quella di suo padre Rogério Rodrigues, stimato giornalista portoghese. Negli ultimi giorni di vita in ospedale, Rogério iniziò a scrivere un articolo, annotando ogni giorno su un quaderno la propria esperienza di paziente terminale. Entrambi sapevano che sarebbe stato il suo ultimo testo. Dopo la sua morte, Tiago aprì quel quaderno e trovò soltanto poche righe, punti, segni incerti, scarabocchi quasi infantili. È da quel vuoto che nasce No Yogurt for the Dead (a Romaeuropa, Teatro Vascello, il 24 e 25 ottobre). È il desiderio di immaginare le pagine mai scritte e di dare voce a ciò che è rimasto sospeso.

Lasciare la Georgia, restare, tornare

Per la nuova Stagione di Emilia Romagna Teatro ERT / Teatro Nazionale, dal titolo Opera aperta, debutta a Cesena, Teatro Bonci, il 23 e 24 ottobre, Gone di Kepler-452 . Dopo il loro progetto sul soccorso in mare A Place of Safety , tornano a misurarsi con il fenomeno della migrazione, documentato attraverso vite reali, confini e ferite collettive. GONE (coproduzione ERT con Lepl Mikheil Tumanishvili Film Actors Professional State Theatre che ha debuttato lo scorso maggio in Georgia) nasce dall’incontro tra Enrico Baraldi e Nicola Borghesi con un gruppo di attrici e attori di Tbilisi.

In un momento storico in cui una parte consistente della popolazione georgiana sta lasciando il proprio paese, la compagnia, insieme all’autore Riccardo Tabilio , ha costruito uno spettacolo documentario basato sulle biografie degli interpreti e su interviste a chi è partito, a chi è rimasto, a chi è stato costretto a tornare, mettendo a nudo le contraddizioni, i paradossi, i desideri e i legami che si spezzano quando qualcuno parte.

A Palermo, prima nazionale de La Governante

Ci sono dei testi che resistono al tempo, come pietre d’inciampo piantate nel cuore della coscienza collettiva. La governante di Vitaliano Brancati è uno di questi. Scritto nel 1952, sepolto dalla censura per oltre un decennio, torna oggi con la forza tagliente di un’opera che ha ancora molto da dire.

Brancati ci consegna un dramma che scava nei meccanismi sotterranei del perbenismo, nei silenzi della morale imposta, nella colpa come strumento di controllo sociale. Lo fa con una struttura teatrale apparentemente classica, nella quale i piccoli incidenti e i grandi malintesi – alla maniera di Čechov – si trasformano in detonatori emotivi. Ma dietro la forma sobria si nasconde una materia incandescente.

La regia di Valerio Santoro non vuole modernizzare La governante , vuole restituirla per quello che è: un dramma crudele e lucidissimo, che racconta come l’intolleranza si celi spesso dietro le forme più rassicuranti.

“La governante”, di Vitaliano Brancati, regia Valerio Santoro, con Franco Branciaroli, Giovanna Di Rauso, Massimo De Matteo, Emanuele Fortunati, Valentina Violo, Eletta Del Castillo, Paride Benassai, Carolina Sisto; scene Luigi Ferrigno, costumi Dora Argento, musiche Paolo Coletta, sound designer Hubert Westkemper, luci Cesare Accetta. Produzione Teatro Biondo Palermo / Marche Teatro. A Palermo, Teatro Biondo, fino al 25 ottobre.

Dialogare con dieci piante

Il mondo vegetale non è uno sfondo ma un universo con cui condividiamo il mondo e con cui forse dobbiamo imparare a dialogare. Pezzo a due con dieci piante , di conferenza balaam (a Milano, Teatro Fontana il 23 e 24 ottobre, nell’ambito di Fontana Studio), nasce da questa riflessione e attraversa il confine tra umano e vegetale attraverso suoni, gesti, racconti e ricerca scientifica.

In scena un Ragazzo, una Biologa e un Musicista/Giardiniere incontrano dieci piante vive, provando a instaurare con loro una relazione che non passi necessariamente dall’idea di renderle simili a noi. Memorie personali, rituali, cura e mancanze si intrecciano alle più recenti ricerche sulla comunicazione tra le piante, mentre un sensore traduce in suono i loro segnali elettrici, rendendo percepibile qualcosa che normalmente resta invisibile.

Il danno, coreografia di Susanna Beltrami

Ci sono storie che in cui una passione proibita sconvolge gli equilibri, mette a nudo le fragilità umane e rivela il peso delle nostre scelte. Così ne Il Danno , lo spettacolo della coreografa Susanna Beltrami che prende ispirazione dal romanzo di Josephine Hart e dal film diretto da Louis Malle (a Milano, Teatro Franco Parenti, il 23 e 24 ottobre, produzione DANCEHAUSpiù).

Un uomo di mezza età, è tormentato dai ricordi, dai sensi di colpa causati dalla travolgente e torbida relazione avuta con la nuora e la conseguente morte del figlio. Una relazione proibita che smaschera la vera natura dei due amanti. Ma è anche una storia d’amore intrisa di follia, morte, mistero, dove i due protagonisti sono, allo stesso tempo, vittime e carnefici del loro destino. In questa rilettura, il figlio del protagonista ritorna trasfigurato in diverse forme, rinnovando traumi e colpe che non possono essere cancellate.

In scena, Emanuela Montanari, Antonino Sutera , già primi ballerini del Teatro alla Scala, con il giovane danzatore Nicolò Brizzi , e la partitura video di Salvatore Lazzaro .

Nella Baraonda del potere

L’abuso di potere non si nasconde più: si mostra ogni giorno nella sua violenza e volgarità mentre le nostre vite scorrono dentro un flusso caotico di immagini, notizie, commenti, meme e emoji. Allo stesso tempo, benché tutto venga iper-esposto appare tutto come un inganno ben orchestrato. Viviamo in una Baraonda.

In scena il presidente Ubu e lo scienziato Achras osservano attraverso una teca le vittime innocenti del loro gioco di potere. Due uomini all’apparenza, in sostanza due maschere del potere. In scena una grossa teca, che è allo stesso tempo luogo di esposizione e strumento di controllo che non risparmia neppure il pubblico. In questo paesaggio la violenza non lascia tracce, ma continua a riprodursi sotto la superficie, invisibile e normalizzata. Esisterà un modo per riuscire a salvare l’innocenza da questa brutalità?

“Baraonda”, liberamente ispirato a Ubu Cocu di Alfred Jarry, traduzione e adattamento di Francesca Garolla, drammaturgia e regia GRUPPO UROR, con Evelina Rosselli e Caterina Rossi, scene Luca Giombi, costumi Caterina Rossi, light designer Camilla Piccioni, sound designer Federico Mezzana. Produzione Teatro Metastasio di Prato. A Prato, Teatro Fabbricone, dal 20 al 25 ottobre.

Lo scarto tra corpo live e corpo montato

Nell’ambito di “ GenerAzione Danza – Sinergie performative tra corpi, luoghi e architetture sonore” , rassegna multidisciplinare diffusa, ideata da Maria Carpaneto per l’associazione Il filo di paglia/MOWlab, in codirezione artistica con ELF Teatro, il 25 ottobre a Il Cielo sotto Milano debutta Fuoricampo ideazione, performance, interpretazione, testi, video, fotografia e montaggio a cura della giovane danzatrice Melania Pallini .

Fuoricampo è un progetto costola del canale YouTube @bruttomavero – aperto da Pallini nel 2017 come palcoscenico intimo di circa 20 video-danze diaristiche – che indaga proprio ciò che il canale non mostra: lo scarto tra corpo live e corpo montato. Cosa c’è tra ciò che inquadra e ciò che viene inquadrato?

Vicino, Vicinissimo, ritrovarsi in relazione

Ideato dal coreografo Daniele Ninarello in sinergia con Gender Bender (di cui è artista associato) e in dialogo con gli spazi di Esprit Nouveau progettato da Le Corbusier , dove l’architettura appare come un sistema di relazioni, Vicino, Vicinissimo riflette sul concetto di transindividualità, sull’esistere come una costruzione in divenire.

Ritrovarsi in un luogo in cui ogni corpo apre nuove visioni, genera nuovi spazi, orizzonti illuminanti, futuri possibili dove attraverso un processo continuo di interazione tra i corpi e lo spazio, le partecipanti attivano un meccanismo di corrispondenze nello stesso modo in cui le architetture di Esprit Nouveau si rivelano grazie a molteplici relazioni che inducono ad aprire lo sguardo, a riposizionarsi e percepirsi uniti nel profondo.

L’insieme delle relazioni apparirà come un flusso continuo, un organismo vivo che avanza e si trasforma: una durational performance aperta al pubblico, il 24 e 25 ottobre.

EgriBiancoDanza a Verbania

Il primo appuntamento di Maggiore_Danza 2026/2027 intitolato Nuovi sguardi, vede in scena EgriBiancoDanza con una serata in due tempi: Brides of God , e Cantata Profana: Il Cervo Fatato , coreografie da Raphael Bianco (il 21 ottobre, Teatro Il Maggiore di Verbania; il 27 ottobre a Saronno, Teatro Giuditta Pasta).

In Brides of God , la compagnia si confronta con il patrimonio della danza classica indiana, a partire dalle Devadasi: donne consacrate alla danza e al divino, oggi al centro di una rilettura critica. La coreografia procede in una dimensione onirica e visionaria in cui affiorano desideri, paure e tensioni interiori.

Cantata Profana: Il Cervo Fatato , si ispira alla Cantata Profana di Béla Bartók , tratta da un’antica leggenda transilvana. Bianco ne indaga simbologia e drammaturgia e sposta il fuoco sul rapporto tra padre e figlio, già cuore del dialogo tra baritono e tenore nella partitura.

Amélie, il Musical dal film omonimo

Tratto dall’omonimo film campione d’incassi amato in tutto il mondo, Amélie – Il Musical porta in scena la magia e la poesia della celebre storia ambientata nel cuore di una Parigi senza tempo. Tra i tavolini del Café des 2 Moulins sogni, ricordi e incontri imprevisti si intrecciano dando vita a una favola moderna fatta di piccole coincidenze e grandi emozioni. Al centro del racconto c’è una ragazza capace di trasformare i gesti più semplici in frammenti di meraviglia.

Nel ruolo della protagonista Giulia Ottonello , e un cast di quattordici performer (a Roma, Teatro Brancaccio, dal 22 al 25 ottobre). La realizzazione teatrale italiana (produzione Ad Astra Entertainment in co-produzione con Compagnia delle Formiche e Fabrizio di Fiore Entertainment & Fdf Gat), ha le musiche originali di Daniel Messé , le liriche di Daniel Messé e Nathan Tysen e il libretto di Craig Lucas – è interamente cantata dal vivo in lingua italiana. La regia e le coreografie sono firmate da Eugenio Contenti , con la direzione musicale di Fabio Serri .

Dalla Corea Yanghee Lee, tra tradizione e contemporaneità

Artista sud–coreana che esplora attraverso la coreografia i punti di incontro tra tradizione e performance contemporanea, Yanghee Lee arriva per la prima volta in Italia nell’ambito della nona edizione di FOG, con il suo ultimo lavoro Shimmering (alla Triennale Milano Teatro, il 24 e 25 ottobre) tassello conclusivo della trilogia Dance’s Pleasure . Combinando la danza tradizionale Shinmuyong e la cultura rave degli anni’90 con l’arte visiva, la moda e la musica elettronica, il lavoro si snoda come una sinfonia, con un susseguirsi di temi, composizioni e variazioni, che intrecciano le forme del canone classico, fondate su una rigorosa disciplina e sulla ripetizione, con le pulsanti texture visive e sonore della cultura rave degli anni Novanta.

12 interpreti si muovono all’interno di un ritmo collettivo che combina tecnica e improvvisazione. Il linguaggio coreografico di trasforma la scena in un luogo vibrante, dove il passato e il presente si incontrano in un’esperienza rituale ed estatica.

CAFÉ JOSÉPHINE a Venezia

Per la prima volta Venice Cocktail Week propone una sinergia tra danza contemporanea e il mondo dei bar, con CAFÉ JOSÉPHINE. Parigi – New York – Venezia. Il sogno cosmopolita , scegliendo l’Orient Express come palcoscenico per il debutto veneziano, il 21 ottobre, della performance. Il progetto performativo site-specific – con concept, regia e coreografia di Francesca Lettieri (Compagnia ADARTE) – trasporta le atmosfere di Parigi, New York e Venezia per una sera in un palcoscenico fuori dal tempo dove la danza incontra musiche e costumi d’epoca, rievocando la magia e l’energia travolgente dei café-chantant.

article_text:
The Quiet Machine by Claerbout at the Fondazione MAST is a challenging surprise

The Quiet Machine , the first major solo exhibition in Italy by Belgian artist David Claerbout , is showing at the Fondazione MAST in Bologna. It explores the relationship between industry, technology and nature through a series of images that come together to create an intriguing balance between reality and the unreal.

Curated by Francesco Zanot, this exhibition is one of the most comprehensive retrospectives of Claerbout’s work. Nine film installations, including two previously unseen works, and a dozen drawings are on display on the first floor of MAST, alongside a site-specific installation on the ground floor.

Complexity is a key feature of this exhibition. After all, Claerbout began his career as a painter, then moved towards photography, film, and new media, producing works in which these disciplines exist both individually and in combination with one another.

His works are the result of a sophisticated and constantly updated computational infrastructure: photographs taken in different places and at different times are used as source material and recomposed into a single visual flow; 3D modelling, animation, generative software and artificial intelligence all contribute to creating images that are as realistic as they are unreal, in which reality and fiction intertwine, challenging our perception of time and image. And thus, a well-balanced and sophisticated blend of elements creates a stunning visual impact, with time assuming an essential role.

The author shapes time, fragmenting it or stretching it out. It is closely related to the duration of his works, as they are not created in the blink of an eye: their creation can take a whole day or stretch on indefinitely, as in the case of his real-time computer-generated film. Temporality and duration result in suspended images that suggest a continuous process of changing, whilst excluding events. The focus, therefore, is on the process, turning the works into “quiet machines” amidst the proliferation of images that are continually produced, consumed and forgotten.

Yet again, layered realities emerge, culminating in something imperceptibly unreal. This also applies to another theme explored by David Claerbout: nature, which is conceived as part of a continuum with the technological world. So, according to the author, the forest and the algorithm, plant growth and industrial production all follow the same principle, namely that nothing is static; nothing is ever truly complete. Another theme is work, which is also depicted and enacted in a variety of dimensions. There is the artist’s theoretical and technical work, that of the machine (the software, the algorithm, the graphics engine), that of the film’s protagonists and, certainly not least, that of the visitors.

Finally, the films: nine in total, from 2009 to the present. First is Sunrise , which shows a maid tidying a house still shrouded in darkness before its inhabitants wake up. Once her work is done, she walks away, while night gives way to dawn. Then, Breathing Bird , in which two birds, facing each other, enter each other’s field of vision while remaining physically separated by a pane of glass.

Then, Oil Workers (from the Shell company of Nigeria, returning home from work, caught in torrential rain) . Meticulously constructed using 3D modelling software from a small JPEG image found online, it depicts a group of men taking shelter from the monsoon rain and looking forward to better times, both in terms of the weather and, perhaps, in life.

The Woodcarver and the Forest , a 24-hour film, centres on a man who slowly carves thousands of wooden spoons while the forest around him gradually disappears. Through minimal, repetitive actions, Claerbout establishes a connection between the time for manual labour and that of environmental transformation.

In The Close and Aircraft (F.A.L.) , an aeroplane is depicted floating inside an industrial warehouse, suspended between assembly and abandonment. Claerbout combines the real space with an elaborate digital reconstruction to create the illusion of a photographic reality. The aeroplane seems both to be under construction and already obsolete, superimposing the future and the past in an impossible sense of time.

Finally, Eagle Eye , a previously unseen film lasting several hours. It centres on an eagle lying on an operating table and filmed from various angles. The film, created using archive footage of rescued birds of prey, has been reworked through an animation process combining CGI and generative artificial intelligence, evoking the enigmatic relationship between the artificial and computational realm and organic life.

Another previously unseen work is The Forest and the Wood , which features a digitally constructed larch forest that is gradually felled by a team of virtual workers. The forest is then reconstructed by simply reversing the timeline of the film. Claerbout contrasts the reversibility of the digital world with natural processes.

The exhibition also features twelve drawings that represent another aspect of the artist’s work. Here, technological complexity gives way to the fundamental relationship between thought, manual skill, and the mark. Reflecting on technology is a fundamental part of his artistic practice, contributing to the development of a multifaceted and complex artistic language, though technology never takes centre stage.

A bilingual (Italian and English) booklet published by the MAST Foundation accompanies the exhibition. A series of events for the public, families and children, including talks, presentations and workshops, are free to attend.

Paola Sammartano

David Claerbout : The Quiet Machine 29 October 2026 – 7 February 2027 Fondazione MAST Via Speranza, 42 40133 Bologna www.mast.org

Die AfD warb in ihrem Parteiprogramm für Sachsen-Anhalt mit der Förderung deutschen Denkens. Was verraten die Unklarheiten dieses Ausdrucks über die Partei?

Wenn eine Partei, die "Deutschland" in ihrem Namen führt, in ihr Programm aufnimmt, man werde in Zukunft "deutsch denken", ist dies nicht überraschend. Für unvoreingenommene Zeitgenossen und Wissenschaftler, zumal Geisteswissenschaftler, wirkt die Parole aber doch irritierend. Denn was kann man seriös damit meinen, deutsch zu denken? Wodurch wird Denken, also ein allgemeiner mentaler,…
excerpt_original: Was heißt "deutsch denken"? Daniel Völzke Sun, 11/08/2026 - 12:47

article_text:
EXCLUSIVE: NewFilmmakers Los Angeles ( NFMLA ) has announced an inaugural partnership with the Mar del Plata International Film Festival in Argentina .

Under the collaboration, NFMLA will bring a selection of eight short films by its alumni to the festival in November, and participate in an industry panel exploring the role that film festivals, markets and creative organizations play in building sustainable careers for emerging storytellers.

The showcase includes coming-of-age comedy The Almost Adults by Brazilian director Rafaella Buzzi , who is currently developing her first feature film Large Land Crisis, as well as Mexican writer, director and producer Alan Maldonado’s Lobo: Christmas Special , about a seven-year-old boy who receives a Polly Pocket toy and must defend both his treasured gift and his emerging sense of identity against his older brother’s bullying.

Related Stories

NewFilmmakers Los Angeles Unveils DocuSlate Documentary Film Festival Lineup Featuring World, North American, U.S. Premieres & More

Venice Parallel Section Giornate Degli Autori Unveils 2026 Winners

Further titles include Los Angeles-based Brazilian writer and director Rodrigo Carvalhedo’s Musings , following an uninspired poet whose encounter with her Muse sparks a journey into the nature of creativity and inspiration; Korean-American filmmaker, writer and cinematographer Yohahn Ko’s intimate and psychologically tense family drama Earboy , and writer, director and AFI Conservatory graduate Gianfranco Fernández-Ruiz’s When Big People Lie which premiered at Telluride and received Best Short Film Drama at NFMLA’s Annual Awards.

Watch on Deadline

The selection also features Venezuelan screenwriter and filmmaker Bettina López Mendoza’s Más Allá , following a young girl navigating the dangerous Darién Gap between Colombia and Panama; folk horror Haint by Jahmil Eady, who was raised between New York City and South Carolina’s Gullah Geechee community; and Is It Like, A Date?!? by Los Angeles-based writer, filmmaker and playwright Eliana Pipes.

The eight short films be showcased in a special out of competition event on November 8, combining screenings and filmmaker Q&As to providing audiences and attending industry members with an opportunity to engage directly with participating artists and explore the inspirations, creative decisions and experiences behind their work.

The new partnership builds on a relationship which strengthened last year when NFMLA Executive Director Larry Laboe attended the 2025 Mar del Plata International Film Festival as a jury member.

NFMLA said it represented an important milestone in its international programming and commitment to connecting independent filmmakers with audiences, industry professionals and cultural institutions around the world.

The creative and curatorial framework for the partnership was developed by Mar del Plata Co-Artistic Directors Gabriel Lerman and Jorge Stamariano, whose vision helped shape the collaboration’s emphasis on discovering distinctive cinematic voices and strengthening connections between filmmaking communities across borders.

The agreement was formally executed by NFMLA Executive Director Larry Laboe and Carlos Luis Pirovano, President of Argentina’s National Film Board, the Instituto Nacional de Cine y Artes Audiovisuales (INCAA), and supported its International Affairs and Film Commission Manager Diego Marambio Avaria.

NFMLA said its aim and that of the festival was to expand access to global exhibition opportunities while encouraging meaningful dialogue between established and emerging film communities.

title_original: Leders Journal (61): Die Doku „Staatsgeheimnis RAF – Terroristen in der DDR“
article_blocks_json: [{"type": "paragraph", "text": "In der ARD-Mediathek ist noch bis 12.10.2028 Claus Räfles Dokumentation „Staatsgeheimnis RAF – Terroristen in der DDR“ zu entdecken. Darin rekonstruiert der Filmemacher, wie ehemalige RAF-Terroristen in der DDR Zuflucht fanden und mit Hilfe der Stasi Identitäten verschleiern konnten. Neben Interviews mit Zeitzeugen kommen dabei auch KI-generierte Bilder zum Einsatz."}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "Wenn etwas zu einer Fernseh-Dokumentation über die DDR passt, dann ist es der Abkürzungswahn, der in der ARD heute so waltet wie einst in dem verblichenen Staat, der sich selbst sozialistisch nannte. So firmiert der neue Film von Claus Räfle in der Sprache der Fernsehbürokraten als „ARD-Doku“, was vermutlich anheimelnd klingen soll. Der Titel des Films klingt schon komplizierter und wird all die abschrecken, die sich vom Reihen-Titel „ARD-Doku“ angezogen fühlten: „ Staatsgeheimnis RAF – Terroristen in der DDR “. (Die Manie zum Untertitel prägte sich zur selben Zeit aus wie der Abkürzungswahn; zwei Seiten derselben Medaille.)", "links": [{"text": "Claus Räfle", "url": "https://www.filmdienst.de/person/details/306389/claus-rafle"}, {"text": "Staatsgeheimnis RAF – Terroristen in der DDR", "url": "https://www.ardmediathek.de/film/staatsgeheimnis-raf-terroristen-in-der-ddr/Y3JpZDovL3JiYi1vbmxpbmUuZGUvc3RhYXRzZ2VoZWltbmlzLXJhZg"}]}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "Der Film wurde am 12. Oktober 2026 abends um 23.25 Uhr im Ersten Programm ausgestrahlt; er steht seitdem in der ARD-Mediathek zum Abruf bereit. Er rekonstruiert die Geschichte, wie Mitte der 1980er-Jahre Mitglieder der Roten Armee-Fraktion (RAF), die aus deren Terror-Geschäft aussteigen wollten, klammheimlich in die DDR übersiedelten, in der sie dann ein kleinbürgerliches Leben als brave Parteigänger des Regimes führten. Sie flogen nach dem Ende der DDR auf."}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "Das könnte Sie auch interessieren:"}, {"type": "list_item", "text": "Leders Journal (60): \"Die Revoluzzer\"", "links": [{"text": "Leders Journal (60): \"Die Revoluzzer\"", "url": "https://www.filmdienst.de/artikel/82170/leders-journal-60-die-revoluzzer"}]}, {"type": "list_item", "text": "Leders Journal (59): Die Gier ist ein Luder - Alexander Held", "links": [{"text": "Leders Journal (59): Die Gier ist ein Luder - Alexander Held", "url": "https://www.filmdienst.de/artikel/81450/alexander-held-und-munchner-mord"}]}, {"type": "list_item", "text": "Leders Journal (58): „Der verlorene Schlaf“ – ein cinephiler Lesetipp", "links": [{"text": "Leders Journal (58): „Der verlorene Schlaf“ – ein cinephiler Lesetipp", "url": "https://www.filmdienst.de/artikel/81114/leders-journal-58-der-verlorene-schlaf-lesetipp"}]}, {"type": "list_item", "text": "Leders Journal (57): Das Fernsehen und die Fußball-WM", "links": [{"text": "Leders Journal (57): Das Fernsehen und die Fußball-WM", "url": "https://www.filmdienst.de/artikel/80684/die-fussball-wm-2026-im-spiegel-der-medien"}]}, {"type": "heading", "text": "Asyl hinter dem Eisernen Vorhang"}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "Die deutschen Strafverfolgungs-Behörden fanden sie 1990 unter ihren neuen Identitäten überraschend schnell, nachdem ihnen Zugang zu den Akten des sich selbst auflösenden Staates gewährt wurde. Denn deren Bürokratie hatte über jede Person, die freiwillig in die DDR ging, umfangreich recherchiert und das auf vielen Seiten umfänglich niedergelegt. Nur bei den RAF-Leuten beschränkten sie sich auf wenige Blatt Papier, weil ihre Anwesenheit selbst für weite Teile der Staatssicherheit (Stasi) geheim gehalten worden war. Diese Pointe eines hochbürokratisierten Systems verrät im Film am Ende Rainer Hofmeyer, der in den 1980er-Jahren die Abteilung Terrorismusbekämpfung im Bundeskriminalamt (BKA) leitete. Seine pointierten Aussagen fallen ohnehin in dem Film auf, in dem andere bundesdeutsche Sicherheitsexperten meist vage bleiben."}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "Ihre Zurückhaltung erklärt sich daraus, dass sie im Fall der in der DDR untergetauchten Terroristen vollkommen falsch lagen. Mal wähnten sie diese im Nahen Osten, wo sie sich bei ihren Gesinnungs- und Mordgenossen der palästinensischen „Befreiungsorganisationen“ weiterbilden sollten, mal sahen sie in ihnen Verdächtige aktueller Anschläge und Attentate in der Bundesrepublik. Einer der Sicherheitsleute sagt denn auch, es sei bestürzend, wie „blind“ sie damals waren. Claus Räfle arbeitet diesen Irrtum, den man als Versagen der ja spätestens 1980 hochgerüsteten Sicherheitsbehörden bezeichnen muss, gut heraus."}, {"type": "image", "url": "https://www.filmdienst.de/bild/filmdb/380948/staatsgeheimnis-raf-artwork.jpg?t=1793008772", "alt": "", "caption": "© rbb/IMAGO/United Archives Keystone/Ruth Geist-Reithmeier", "credit": "Filmdienst"}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "Neu ist an seinem Film allerdings nicht viel. Das liegt auch daran, dass viele der Sachverständigen wie die Historiker Wolfgang Kraushaar und Alexander Straßner oder der Journalist Frank Wilhelm, die Räfle neben den erwähnten Sicherheitsleuten befragte, über Aspekte dieser Geschichte längst Bücher und Artikel geschrieben haben. Auch seine Hauptzeugin, Silke Meier-Witt, hat sich nicht nur in einem eigenen Buch, das 2025 erschien, sondern auch in Interviews mehrfach über die Übersiedlung und ihre Zeit in der DDR geäußert."}, {"type": "heading", "text": "Mantel des Schweigens"}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "Dass sie immer wieder gefragt wird, liegt auch daran, dass sie anders als die meisten ihrer RAF-Genossinnen und Genossen der 1970er- und 1980er-Jahre das Schweigegelübde gebrochen hat, das die anderen bis heute sklavisch befolgen. Das Schweigen stellt gleichsam den letzten ideologischen Besitz der RAF dar, während all das, was sie mal als ihre Politik behauptet hatte, sich längst als der selbstgerechte Irrsinn herausstellte, der er immer schon war."}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "Aber die RAF-Kader, die meist nach langer Gefängnishaft entlassen unter anderem Namen irgendwo in Deutschland leben, schweigen nicht allein. Auch die Spitzenfunktionäre der Stasi, die von der Übersiedlung der zehn RAF-Frauen und Männer wussten, sagen nicht aus. Vielleicht aus einem ähnlichen Grund; wenigstens ihr geheimes Wissen haben sie dem Klassenfeind, dem sie 1989 unterlagen, voraus. So ist über den Geheimdienst der DDR vieles bekannt, was die Ausspähung und Verfolgung der eigenen Bevölkerung angeht, aber wenig, was ihre strategischen Ziele jenseits der Sicherheit im eigenen Land angeht."}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "Im Film ist irgendwann die Rede davon, dass eine Information aus dem BKA schnurstracks zum sowjetischen Geheimdienst und von diesem an die Stasi gelangt sei. Aber wer wann was aus den deutschen Strafverfolgungsbehörden in die Sowjetunion und die DDR getragen hat, wird nicht gesagt. Vermutlich, weil man den Verräter immer noch nicht kennt. Hofmeyer gesteht immerhin, dass man heute weiß, dass die DDR angeblich sichere Glasfaserleitungen und Richtfunkstrecken zwischen der Bundesrepublik und West-Berlin angezapft hatte und so mithörte, wie bundesdeutsche Geheimdienstler Geheimnisvolles austauschten."}, {"type": "heading", "text": "Ob es eine Kooperation zwischen Stasi und RAF gab, bleibt unklar"}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "In Räfles Film kommt neben den vielen Bundesdeutschen allein eine Bürgerin der ehemaligen DDR vor; sie hatte sich mit Silke Meier-Witt, die Ende der 1980er-Jahre in Neubrandenburg lebte, angefreundet. Diese Frau fügt dem Film eine weitere Geschichtspointe bei: Als Ende der 1980er-Jahre die Kritik an Staat und Partei in der DDR lauter wurde, trat Silke Meier-Witt der alles bestimmenden Sozialistischen Einheitspartei Deutschlands (SED) bei. article_text:
In der ARD-Mediathek ist noch bis 12.10.2028 Claus Räfles Dokumentation „Staatsgeheimnis RAF – Terroristen in der DDR“ zu entdecken. Darin rekonstruiert der Filmemacher, wie ehemalige RAF-Terroristen in der DDR Zuflucht fanden und mit Hilfe der Stasi Identitäten verschleiern konnten. Neben Interviews mit Zeitzeugen kommen dabei auch KI-generierte Bilder zum Einsatz.

Wenn etwas zu einer Fernseh-Dokumentation über die DDR passt, dann ist es der Abkürzungswahn, der in der ARD heute so waltet wie einst in dem verblichenen Staat, der sich selbst sozialistisch nannte. So firmiert der neue Film von Claus Räfle in der Sprache der Fernsehbürokraten als „ARD-Doku“, was vermutlich anheimelnd klingen soll. Der Titel des Films klingt schon komplizierter und wird all die abschrecken, die sich vom Reihen-Titel „ARD-Doku“ angezogen fühlten: „ Staatsgeheimnis RAF – Terroristen in der DDR “. (Die Manie zum Untertitel prägte sich zur selben Zeit aus wie der Abkürzungswahn; zwei Seiten derselben Medaille.)

Der Film wurde am 12. Oktober 2026 abends um 23.25 Uhr im Ersten Programm ausgestrahlt; er steht seitdem in der ARD-Mediathek zum Abruf bereit. Er rekonstruiert die Geschichte, wie Mitte der 1980er-Jahre Mitglieder der Roten Armee-Fraktion (RAF), die aus deren Terror-Geschäft aussteigen wollten, klammheimlich in die DDR übersiedelten, in der sie dann ein kleinbürgerliches Leben als brave Parteigänger des Regimes führten. Sie flogen nach dem Ende der DDR auf.

Das könnte Sie auch interessieren:

Leders Journal (60): "Die Revoluzzer"

Leders Journal (59): Die Gier ist ein Luder - Alexander Held

Leders Journal (58): „Der verlorene Schlaf“ – ein cinephiler Lesetipp

Leders Journal (57): Das Fernsehen und die Fußball-WM

Asyl hinter dem Eisernen Vorhang

Die deutschen Strafverfolgungs-Behörden fanden sie 1990 unter ihren neuen Identitäten überraschend schnell, nachdem ihnen Zugang zu den Akten des sich selbst auflösenden Staates gewährt wurde. Denn deren Bürokratie hatte über jede Person, die freiwillig in die DDR ging, umfangreich recherchiert und das auf vielen Seiten umfänglich niedergelegt. Nur bei den RAF-Leuten beschränkten sie sich auf wenige Blatt Papier, weil ihre Anwesenheit selbst für weite Teile der Staatssicherheit (Stasi) geheim gehalten worden war. Diese Pointe eines hochbürokratisierten Systems verrät im Film am Ende Rainer Hofmeyer, der in den 1980er-Jahren die Abteilung Terrorismusbekämpfung im Bundeskriminalamt (BKA) leitete. Seine pointierten Aussagen fallen ohnehin in dem Film auf, in dem andere bundesdeutsche Sicherheitsexperten meist vage bleiben.

Ihre Zurückhaltung erklärt sich daraus, dass sie im Fall der in der DDR untergetauchten Terroristen vollkommen falsch lagen. Mal wähnten sie diese im Nahen Osten, wo sie sich bei ihren Gesinnungs- und Mordgenossen der palästinensischen „Befreiungsorganisationen“ weiterbilden sollten, mal sahen sie in ihnen Verdächtige aktueller Anschläge und Attentate in der Bundesrepublik. Einer der Sicherheitsleute sagt denn auch, es sei bestürzend, wie „blind“ sie damals waren. Claus Räfle arbeitet diesen Irrtum, den man als Versagen der ja spätestens 1980 hochgerüsteten Sicherheitsbehörden bezeichnen muss, gut heraus.

Neu ist an seinem Film allerdings nicht viel. Das liegt auch daran, dass viele der Sachverständigen wie die Historiker Wolfgang Kraushaar und Alexander Straßner oder der Journalist Frank Wilhelm, die Räfle neben den erwähnten Sicherheitsleuten befragte, über Aspekte dieser Geschichte längst Bücher und Artikel geschrieben haben. Auch seine Hauptzeugin, Silke Meier-Witt, hat sich nicht nur in einem eigenen Buch, das 2025 erschien, sondern auch in Interviews mehrfach über die Übersiedlung und ihre Zeit in der DDR geäußert.

Mantel des Schweigens

Dass sie immer wieder gefragt wird, liegt auch daran, dass sie anders als die meisten ihrer RAF-Genossinnen und Genossen der 1970er- und 1980er-Jahre das Schweigegelübde gebrochen hat, das die anderen bis heute sklavisch befolgen. Das Schweigen stellt gleichsam den letzten ideologischen Besitz der RAF dar, während all das, was sie mal als ihre Politik behauptet hatte, sich längst als der selbstgerechte Irrsinn herausstellte, der er immer schon war.

Aber die RAF-Kader, die meist nach langer Gefängnishaft entlassen unter anderem Namen irgendwo in Deutschland leben, schweigen nicht allein. Auch die Spitzenfunktionäre der Stasi, die von der Übersiedlung der zehn RAF-Frauen und Männer wussten, sagen nicht aus. Vielleicht aus einem ähnlichen Grund; wenigstens ihr geheimes Wissen haben sie dem Klassenfeind, dem sie 1989 unterlagen, voraus. So ist über den Geheimdienst der DDR vieles bekannt, was die Ausspähung und Verfolgung der eigenen Bevölkerung angeht, aber wenig, was ihre strategischen Ziele jenseits der Sicherheit im eigenen Land angeht.

Im Film ist irgendwann die Rede davon, dass eine Information aus dem BKA schnurstracks zum sowjetischen Geheimdienst und von diesem an die Stasi gelangt sei. Aber wer wann was aus den deutschen Strafverfolgungsbehörden in die Sowjetunion und die DDR getragen hat, wird nicht gesagt. Vermutlich, weil man den Verräter immer noch nicht kennt. Hofmeyer gesteht immerhin, dass man heute weiß, dass die DDR angeblich sichere Glasfaserleitungen und Richtfunkstrecken zwischen der Bundesrepublik und West-Berlin angezapft hatte und so mithörte, wie bundesdeutsche Geheimdienstler Geheimnisvolles austauschten.

Ob es eine Kooperation zwischen Stasi und RAF gab, bleibt unklar

In Räfles Film kommt neben den vielen Bundesdeutschen allein eine Bürgerin der ehemaligen DDR vor; sie hatte sich mit Silke Meier-Witt, die Ende der 1980er-Jahre in Neubrandenburg lebte, angefreundet. Diese Frau fügt dem Film eine weitere Geschichtspointe bei: Als Ende der 1980er-Jahre die Kritik an Staat und Partei in der DDR lauter wurde, trat Silke Meier-Witt der alles bestimmenden Sozialistischen Einheitspartei Deutschlands (SED) bei. Das hatte etwas demonstrativ Bekennendes an sich und war so ein schwerer Verstoß gegen das, was ihr die Stasi als Verhaltensmaßregeln diktiert hatten; die RAF-Leute sollten um keinen Preis auffallen. In genau dem Augenblick, als sich die ausgestiegene Terroristin zur DDR bekannte, trat ihre Freundin aus deren Staatspartei aus.

Bei anderen Aspekten drängt der Film zwar auf Pointen, verfehlt sie aber deutlich. Ob der Mord an Gerold von Braunmühl, den die RAF 1986 beging, nun ein Auftrag der Stasi war, den der sowjetische Geheimdienst angeordnet hatte, ist ebenso wenig bewiesen wie eine generelle Kooperation zwischen den Staatsorganen der DDR und den westdeutschen Terroristen. Hier raunt der von Claudia Urbschat-Mingues gesprochene Kommentar, spricht vage von „brisanten Dokumenten“, oder behauptet, die Stasi sei vom Mord an von Braunmühl „bestens“ informiert, wenn in einem Dokument gerade mal von einem Telefonat in der Tatnacht die Rede ist.

KI-generierte Vergangenheit

So wäre der solide recherchierte Film nicht weiter der Rede wert, wenn er sich nicht durch eine Besonderheit auszeichnete, die bald – so ist zu vermuten – zur neuen Normalität im Fernsehen wird: Viele Szenen des Films tragen links oben die Kennung „Szene mit KI erstellt“. Es handelt sich um Aufnahmen, in der eine per Software um 40 Jahre verjüngte Silke Meier-Witt durch eine ebenso künstlich generierte DDR bewegt. Diese Bilder sind nicht naturalistisch; sie wirken eher so, als stammten sie aus einem Computerspiel der späten 1990er-Jahre.

Sie täuschen also nichts vor, sie visualisieren allein das, was der Kommentar zuvor behauptet hatte. Heißt es bei ihm, Silke Meier-Witt sei in einem „grünen Wartburg“ von der Stasi abgeholt worden, sieht man prompt zunächst diesen groß im Bild und dann, wie die KI-Silke in ihm durch eine unscharfe DDR gondelt. Spricht der Kommentar davon, dass die Untergetauchte, die gerade jemand in der DDR wegen westlicher Fahndungsfotos als RAF-Frau erkannt hatte, unbedingt eine neue Frisur brauchte, sitzt sie stante pede in einem puppenhaft wirkenden DDR-Frisiersalon und ihr werden von einer Frau im olivgrünen Kittel die Haare geschnitten.

Die mit KI generierten Bilder sollen das illustrieren, was der Kommentar aussagt. Sie erfüllen dieselbe Funktion wie bislang – meist unbekannte – Schauspieler im Reenactment historischer Dokumentationen oder von Real-Crime-Formaten: Sie dienen als optisches Füllmaterial. Damit täuschen die Darsteller ebenso wie die KI-Klone etwas vor, was den Filmen am meisten fehlt: Authentisches Bildmaterial. Hier sogar im besonderen Sinne: Die untergetauchten RAF-Leute sollten sich nicht fotografieren lassen, damit ihre Legende nicht platzte. Anstatt dieses Fehlen von Bildern einzugestehen, greift das Fernsehen – animiert durch sein Selbstbild, es könne alles, wenn es nur wolle – zu solchen Surrogaten.

Der Bebilderungswut sind keine Grenzen mehr gesetzt

Mag das, was die Protagonistin Silke Meier-Witt betrifft, noch angehen, denn sie muss ja dieser Darstellung zugestimmt haben, ist es für einen anderen Aspekt der historischen Darstellung problematisch. Der Film zeigt eine per Computer zusammengebastelte DDR, über die man gerne mehr erfahren hätte. Das wird einem spätestens in dem Moment bewusst, wenn Räfle eine Archivaufnahme ausnahmsweise länger stehen lässt. Es handelt sich um eine Flugaufnahme des Zentrums von Ost-Berlin, die für die Modernität der DDR mit den dort errichteten Hochhäusern, der als Prachtstraße hergerichteten Karl-Marx-Allee und dem Alexanderplatz werben sollte.

Weil die Aufnahme länger steht und auch nicht gleich für irgendetwas funktionalisiert wird, kann man für einige Sekunden lang selbst ein Bild der damaligen Verhältnisse gewinnen: Wie sehr diese gefeierte Modernität der DDR dem Leben im Kapitalismus ähnelte. Die Übersiedler der RAF müssen solche Bilder irritiert haben; sie dachten, sie seien der kapitalistischen Moderne entflohen, da ersteht diese in einer sozialistischen Variante neben ihnen wieder auf.

Der Bebilderungszwang des Fernsehens wird sich auf die Bildproduktion der KI so stürzen wie der Dürstende in der Wüste auf ein Glas Wasser. Nun kann man alles das herstellen, was einem fehlt.

"credit": "Filmdienst", "translated": true}, {"type": "heading", "text": "AI 创建的过去", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "因此,坚固的研究的电影不值得再说话,如果它没有被特征,即即将成为电视上的新正常性:电影的许多场景在左上方的标志“创建的场景与人工智能”。 这些场景是通过软件40年青春的Silk Meier-White通过同样的人工创造的DDR移动的录像。这是1990年代末的电脑游戏。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "因此,他们不欺骗任何东西,他们只是想象了评论之前所说的话。 说到他,Silk Meier-Witt在一个“绿色Wartburg”被斯塔西带走了,你会立即看到这个大小在图像中,然后,人工智能的Silk在他里面通过一个不干净的DDR。她必然需要一个新的发型,她坐在一个令人震惊的DDR发型厅,她将被一个女人在橄榄绿链中剪头发。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "用人工智能创建的图像应该描述评论所说的话;它们在历史文档或现实犯罪格式的重新启动中扮演相同的角色;它们作为视觉填充材料;因此,像人工智能克隆一样,演员会想象电影中最缺乏的东西:真实的图像材料;甚至在特殊的意义上:无视的RAF人不应该被拍摄;而不是承认这种缺乏图像,电视 - 由自己的自我形象动画,它可以做任何事情,如果它只是想 - 攻击这样的冲浪。", "translated": true}, {"type": "heading", "text": "图形愤怒不再设定边界", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "对于主角Silke Meier-Witt而言,这可能还会发生,因为她必须同意这场演出,这对历史演出的另一个方面是困难的,这部电影展示了一部计算机组合的DDR,你想知道更多,这将是最迟在那一刻,当Refle允许档案录制更长时间,这是一个飞行录制的东柏林中心,为DDR的现代化与在那里建造的高房屋,应该宣传作为美丽之路建造的卡尔·马克思·阿利和亚历山大广场。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "因为拍摄时间更长,甚至不像什么事一样,我们可以几秒钟内自己获得当时的关系的形象:这个庆祝的现代化是多么相似于资本主义生活的; RAF 过境者必须激动这些形象;他们以为它们是资本主义现代的流浪,所以它在社会主义的变种中在他们旁边再次出现。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "电视的图像强迫将像沙漠中的沉没一样落在人工智能的图像制作上,现在你可以做你所缺少的一切。", "translated": true}]

article_text:
La película de Christopher Nolan desembarcará en formato digital en noviembre, tras su exitoso paso por los cines. Su estreno en un servicio de streaming por suscripción todavía es una incógnita.

Después de conquistar al público en las salas, La Odisea se prepara para dar sus primeros pasos fuera de la pantalla grande. La nueva película de Christopher Nolan ya tiene fecha de lanzamiento para su alquiler y compra digital, aunque quienes esperen encontrarla en el catálogo de una plataforma de streaming deberán tener un poco más de paciencia.

La producción, protagonizada por Matt Damon , adapta el célebre poema épico de Homero y sigue las aventuras de Odiseo durante su largo regreso a Ítaca después de la Guerra de Troya. En el camino, el héroe deberá superar peligros, enfrentarse a criaturas mitológicas y sortear distintos obstáculos para volver a reunirse con su esposa Penélope, interpretada por Anne Hathaway, y su hijo Telémaco, a quien da vida Tom Holland.

El reparto se completa con figuras como Robert Pattinson , Zendaya , Charlize Theron , Lupita Nyong’o , Samantha Morton , Jon Bernthal y John Leguizamo , entre otros nombres destacados.

La película tendrá su lanzamiento digital el próximo 17 de noviembre de 2026 , una fecha que permitirá a los espectadores disfrutarla desde sus hogares. Además, la edición incluirá materiales especiales que revelarán detalles sobre el ambicioso proceso de producción encabezado por Nolan.

Los detalles detrás de la producción de La Odisea

Uno de los atractivos del lanzamiento será el contenido adicional, que ofrecerá más de 90 minutos de material sobre la realización de la película. La propuesta contempla 12 piezas especiales con imágenes del rodaje, entrevistas y detalles sobre las decisiones artísticas y técnicas que dieron forma a esta adaptación de la mitología griega.

¿Dónde fue filmada La Odisea de Christopher Nolan?

Christopher Nolan prohibió que usarán ésta prenda en el rodaje de ‘La Odisea’

Los espectadores podrán conocer cómo se construyeron los escenarios, cómo se diseñaron los vestuarios y de qué manera el equipo trasladó al cine algunos de los episodios más emblemáticos del relato de Homero. También habrá material dedicado a la recreación de Troya y a las locaciones utilizadas para representar Ítaca.

La producción combinó rodajes en diferentes lugares del mundo con escenarios construidos especialmente para la película. Entre ellos se encuentra un castillo del siglo XV situado en la isla italiana de Favignana, utilizado para representar el hogar al que intenta regresar el protagonista.

El apartado técnico también tendrá su espacio, con detalles sobre las secuencias de acción, los efectos visuales y especiales y el rodaje de las escenas marítimas. Además, Ludwig Göransson explicará el trabajo realizado para crear la banda sonora, en la que recurrió a instrumentos antiguos, voces y distintas técnicas musicales.

La edición física incorporará algunos extras exclusivos, como una entrevista del creador de contenido Reece Feldman a Nolan, un prólogo especial para IMAX y el videoclip de When I’m Home , interpretado por James Blake, Travis Scott y Göransson.

¿Cuándo se estrena La Odisea en HBO Max?

El primer paso para ver La Odisea en casa será el 17 de noviembre de 2026 , cuando estará disponible para alquiler y compra digital en plataformas como Apple TV y Prime Video . Ese mismo día también está previsto el lanzamiento de las ediciones físicas en 4K UHD, Blu-ray y DVD.

Sin embargo, esta fecha no corresponde a su estreno en streaming por suscripción . Por el momento, no se anunció cuándo podrá verse sin costo adicional dentro del catálogo de un servicio.

Una posibilidad es que la película siga una estrategia de distribución similar a la de Oppenheimer , otro de los grandes éxitos de Nolan, que tardó varios meses en incorporarse a una plataforma de streaming. La repercusión comercial de la nueva producción y su posible presencia en la temporada de premios podrían influir en los tiempos de lanzamiento.

En Latinoamérica, HBO Max aparece como una posible candidata para recibir la película, teniendo en cuenta los antecedentes de distribución de Universal Pictures en la región . De todos modos, todavía no se confirmó qué plataforma tendrá los derechos de exhibición por suscripción.

Mientras tanto, los fanáticos de Nolan podrán acceder a la película a través de las opciones de alquiler y compra digital desde noviembre. Para su llegada al streaming tradicional, habrá que esperar novedades oficiales.
